titulo: A Study of Insulin Efsitora Alfa (LY3209590) Compared to Degludec in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Who Are Starting Basal Insulin for the First Time

braco.texto:
* Participants received 500 units per milliliter (U/mL) of insulin efsitora alfa administered subcutaneously (SC) once weekly (QW) over a 52-week treatment period, followed by a 5-week safety follow-up period.
* Participants continued their protocol-specified stable therapy with non-insulin antihyperglycemic medications throughout the study, at the discretion of the investigator.

titulo: A Study of Insulin Efsitora Alfa (LY3209590) as a Weekly Basal Insulin Compared to Insulin Glargine in Adult Participants With Type 2 Diabetes on Multiple Daily Injections

braco.texto: Participants received 500 units per milliliter (U/mL) Insulin Efsitora Alfa (insulin efsitora) administered subcutaneously (SC) once weekly (QW) along with 100 U/mL insulin lispro given SC with meals as needed.
